label: ADG 5/5 Legit Terminals (M7/F7 roleset)
source: ADG updated all-class M7 POV text and POV clips supplied by the user
notes: Source: ADG all-class M7/F7 role guide (Maxor, Storm, Terminals S1-S4, Goldor, Necron, Relics, Dragons) supplied by the user.
Every row below is "who leaps to whom, when and where" from that guide, seeded into this mod's cell matrix (stage/step/class -> target).

Detection so nothing fires by accident: the fight phase (Maxor/Storm/Goldor/Necron/Wither King) and the Goldor section gate every leap - a row can only fire in its own phase and section. Storm entry (P2.GY.1) additionally waits for the berserk to be at storm_entry.
Conds use onFail ANY_AFTER: if a landmark was never captured or its position isn't met yet, the step waits anyAfterMs then leaps anyway, so the ladder never stalls on a missing landmark.

Landmarks to capture with /leaputils landmark <name>: storm_entry (where the berserk drops into Storm), storm_purple (purple jump pad), storm_yellow (yellow jump pad), terms_ee (ee2/ee3 spot), terms_core (core tunnel spot), necron_relic (P4 relic spot).

Raw coordinate conds: a cond can use raw xyz instead of a named landmark, e.g. {"x": 123.4, "y": 64.0, "z": -456.7, "radius": 5}. The error margin (radius) is user-customisable per cond and defaults to the mode's radius (AT=2m, NEAR/IN=8m). "subject": "TARGET" checks where the person you would leap to is; "subject": "SELF" checks where you are.

Not encoded - melody branches, boss HP, device/terminal completion, mob spawns, gear swaps, mask pops and pad movement: those leaps rely on step order and the user opening the menu when the guide says to.
Storm variant seeded: Green-Yellow (P2.GY). Old/New purple routes are left unseeded (empty rows).
P5/Wither King dragons are seeded but the Wither King toggle is off by default; turn it on in Savepoint settings to use P5.
Blood rush / camp and anything before Maxor are not part of this preset.

P1.1.label: crystal group 1
P1.1.desc: Berserk right crystal -> Healer on right pad; Archer left crystal -> Tank on left pad.

P1.2.label: crystal group 2
P1.2.desc: Grab the second set and repeat: Berserk -> Healer, Archer -> Tank.

P2.GY.1.label: Storm entry
P2.GY.1.desc: Everyone leaps the Berserk (he dug down after Maxor); Berserk leaps Archer to clear mobs.

P2.GY.2.label: purple pad setup
P2.GY.2.desc: Mage sets up the purple pad and leaps Archer to clear remaining archers.

P2.GY.3.label: after lightning
P2.GY.3.desc: Mage leaps Healer at the purple pad; Healer later leaps Berserk for the SS dropoff.

P2.GY.4.label: after the crush
P2.GY.4.desc: Tank -> Healer, Mage -> Tank on yellow, Archer -> Mage at enrage.

P3.S1.ENTRY.1.label: S1 entry
P3.S1.ENTRY.1.desc: When Storm ends, Mage/Tank/Archer leap the Healer (SS anchor).

P3.S1.1.label: after SS / i4
P3.S1.1.desc: Healer -> Mage for ee2; Berserk -> Tank after i4.

P3.S1.2.label: S1 finishes
P3.S1.2.desc: Tank/Archer/Berserk leap Mage for ee2 once SS is done.

P3.S2.1.label: S2 term 1
P3.S2.1.desc: Healer lands at 1, completes terminal, then leaps Berserk.

P3.S2.2.label: S2 ee3
P3.S2.2.desc: Berserk (after 5 then 3) and Archer leap Healer at ee3.

P3.S3.1.label: S3 terminals
P3.S3.1.desc: Healer/Berserk/Archer leap Mage after their terminal or device for core.

P3.S3.2.label: S3 core
P3.S3.2.desc: Tank leaps Mage into core after his terminal 1 and levers.

P3.S4.1.label: S4 entry
P3.S4.1.desc: Archer leaps Mage to enter S4 and runs to his terminal.

P3.S4.2.label: after S4 terminal
P3.S4.2.desc: Archer/Healer/Tank leap Mage again after their terminal/levers.

P3.S4.3.label: after S4 levers
P3.S4.3.desc: Berserk leaps Mage again to get back into core.

P4.1.label: Necron drop
P4.1.desc: Instamid into the far wall; no preset leap here.

P4.2.label: 70m phase
P4.2.desc: Mage/Archer/Berserk/Tank leap the Healer at the 70m hp phase.

P4.3.label: relic handoffs
P4.3.desc: Mage -> Healer (blue pickup) -> Berserk; Healer -> Berserk; Tank -> Archer (green relic).

P5.1.label: after dragon 1
P5.1.desc: Mage -> Tank; Berserk -> Archer to arrowstack dragon 2.
